description: Local mode's engine start in the Node, Rust, C# and Java SDKs (contract/local-engine.md). 'platforms': an operating system, processor and whether an NVIDIA GPU was found, and the jeff-runtime extra chosen or the error. 'folders': the engine folder from the system, HOME and XDG_CACHE_HOME (null: not set). 'uvx': where uvx is found from PATH and HOME, 'executables' being the executable files that exist (every other path does not exist or is not executable). 'adapters': adapter references resolved with the shipped catalogue. 'commands': the argument list that starts the engine. 'log_tails': a log's text and its last lines. 'messages': each line printed and each error, from its inputs. 'shell_starts': the command Java and C# run, from the system, the setsid found (Linux) and the uvx argument list. 'setsid': where setsid is found on Linux, as for 'uvx'.
